detailZones.title: CT scanner body
detailZones.description: Trace the visible CT gantry, tunnels, curtains, housing panels, supports and floor plate.

detailZones.title: Infeed conveyor lane
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible infeed belt, rollers, rails, spill plate, frame, suitcase and floor hardware.

detailZones.title: Operator viewing stations
detailZones.description: Study the visible primary and alternate viewing stations, blank monitors, keyboard, desk and search table.

detailZones.title: X-ray conveyor lane
detailZones.description: Trace the visible X-ray housing, tunnels, belts, diverter hardware, rollers, monitors and base.

detailZones.title: Bins, trays and carry-on bags
detailZones.translation: 托盘、置物箱与随身行李
detailZones.description: Compare the visible blue and gray bins, return lane, trays, cart and plain carry-on bags.

detailZones.title: Service rails and room panels
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible screening-room floor, rails, partitions, service table, shelves, panels and seams.

anchorAudit.rationale: The final 1600 by 900 carry-on scanner photograph was inspected at source and output resolution. It retains 147 independently pointable CT/X-ray machine, conveyor, viewing-station, bin, tray, bag, rail and room-fixture parts. Passenger identity, image content, alarm state, threat detection, screening outcome, security status and hidden algorithms were excluded.
